text: 10 OVERDOSAGE In FELIX study (all cohorts N=127), occurrences of overdose were observed at the administration of the first dose in 4% (5/127) of patients. All 5 patients had bone marrow blasts > 20% and should have received a first dose of 10 × 10 6 CAR-positive viable T cells but instead received a higher dose between 68 and 103 × 10 6 CAR-positive viable T cells. CRS, ICANS and HLH, including severe events, were observed in patients who received overdose of AUCATZYL. In the event of a suspected overdose, closely monitor patients for any adverse reactions and administer treatment according to institutional practice and treatment guidelines.
